steps.title: Fit the motors and clamp the booms under the wing
steps.goal: Both booms parallel under the spar line, a motor on the front of each.

safety.text: A motor screw longer than the joint stack allows reaches the windings. Measure every screw before it goes in.

actions.do: Measure each M3x8 against the saddle: thread in the motor base `4 mm` (minimum `3 mm`).
Fix BMS-003 to the front of BMS-001: 4x M3x8, threadlocker, snug. Same for BMS-004 on BMS-002.
Close a printed clamp round each boom under the spar line: 2x M3x20 from below, washer and nyloc.
Set both booms parallel to the fuselage axis, then tighten the clamps to `0.5 N m`.

check.text: Measure centre to centre between the motor shafts; spin each motor by hand.
check.target: {ex_booms.boom_y_m*2|mm} ± 2 mm; both motors spin freely, no rub

can_go_wrong.fix: Clamp halves touching before they grip: sand 0.3 mm off a mating face, re-torque.
Screw too long: swap to the length in the joint stack.
